leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement variable declarations with explicit type annotations for TypeScript's primitive types
Apply type annotations to initialize variables with string, number, and boolean values
Construct a function that accepts parameters with specific primitive type annotations
Configure variables with const and let declarations while maintaining type safety
Update existing JavaScript variables by adding explicit TypeScript type annotations
Manipulate type-annotated variables through basic operations while preserving type integrity
